applies_why: The judge text resolves the Luke 2:48-49 challenge by saying the phrase in v. 48 is immediately qualified by v. 49, which is the verse-by-verse treatment K-C governs.
quote: Mary's phrase "thy father" is immediately qualified by the child's reference to "my Father's business."
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: never verse by verse — one reading bars treating Luke 2:49 as an immediate qualification of Luke 2:48 in isolation; the other reading permits that immediate intra-passage qualification.
why: The judge did not weigh the chains by footing; it used a verse-level qualification to mark the point underdetermined.
